description: This file contains utility functions for resolving and constructing npm command invocations within a Node.js environment, particularly with platform-specific considerations. It provides methods for finding the local npm executable, building command lines, and handling environment specifics.

methods.name: resolvePathEnvKey
methods.description: Finds the environment variable key used for PATH, case-insensitive, defaulting to 'PATH'.

methods.name: escapeForCmdExe
methods.description: Escapes command line arguments for Windows cmd.exe to prevent unsafe characters from causing issues.

methods.name: buildCmdExeCommandLine
methods.description: Constructs a command line string with properly escaped arguments for Windows command execution.

methods.name: resolveToolchainNpmRunner
methods.description: Attempts to locate the npm CLI script or executable and constructs an appropriate command configuration based on platform.
